Scheme Name: Pradhan Mantri Kisan Samman Nidhi (PM-KISAN)
Scheme ID: PM_KISAN
Category: Agriculture
Alternative Names: PM-KISAN; PM Kisan; PMKISAN; PM Kisan Samman Nidhi; Pradhan Mantri Kisan Samman Nidhi; पीएम-किसान; पीएम किसान; प्रधानमंत्री किसान सम्मान निधि
Description: Central Sector income-support scheme providing financial assistance to eligible landholding farmer families. State and UT authorities verify beneficiary records. Benefits: Eligible farmer families receive Rs. 6,000 per year.; The amount is paid in three equal instalments of Rs. 2,000 through Direct Benefit Transfer to the beneficiary bank account.; eKYC is mandatory for registered beneficiaries. Eligibility: The scheme covers eligible landholding farmer families, defined as husband, wife and minor children.; Institutional landholders and specified higher-income or office-holder categories are excluded.; State or UT land records and official beneficiary verification determine entitlement. Required Documents: Aadhaar details for identity and eKYC.; Bank account details for DBT.; Landholding and farmer records as required by the State or UT.; Additional documents requested during official verification. Application Process: Use the New Farmer Registration facility on the PM-KISAN portal or contact the designated State or UT officials or a CSC.; Complete the required identity and eKYC process.; Check application and payment status using Know Your Status on the official portal.

Scheme Name: Ayushman Bharat - Pradhan Mantri Jan Arogya Yojana (PM-JAY)
Scheme ID: AYUSHMAN_BHARAT_PMJAY
Category: Health
Alternative Names: Ayushman Bharat; Ayushman Bharat PM-JAY; Ayushman Bharat PMJAY; PM-JAY; PMJAY; AB PM-JAY; AB-PMJAY; आयुष्मान भारत; आयुष्मान भारत योजना; प्रधानमंत्री जन आरोग्य योजना; पीएम जन आरोग्य योजना
Description: Government-funded health assurance scheme providing cashless secondary and tertiary hospitalisation cover to eligible beneficiary families at empanelled hospitals. Benefits: Health cover up to Rs. 5 lakh per eligible family per year.; Cashless treatment at empanelled public and private hospitals.; Covered packages can include hospitalisation, applicable day-care procedures, medicines and pre- and post-hospitalisation expenses under scheme rules.; Benefits are portable across participating States and Union Territories. Eligibility: Entitlement is based on the official beneficiary database and applicable State-specific expansion rules.; A person's eligibility cannot be confirmed from income, occupation, caste or age alone.; Check beneficiary status through the official NHA beneficiary portal or an authorised channel. Required Documents: Ayushman card or beneficiary identification details, where available.; Aadhaar or another accepted identity document for verification.; Ration card or family identification details if requested by the State or verification centre. Application Process: Check beneficiary status at https://beneficiary.nha.gov.in/ or through an authorised Ayushman Mitra or Common Service Centre.; Complete identity and family verification if listed as an eligible beneficiary.; Use an empanelled hospital and contact its Ayushman Mitra desk before treatment.

Scheme Name: Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana - Urban (PMAY-U)
Scheme ID: PMAY_URBAN
Category: Housing
Alternative Names: PMAY-U; PMAY Urban; PMAY Urban 2.0; PM Awas Yojana Urban; Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana Urban; प्रधानमंत्री आवास योजना शहरी; प्रधानमंत्री आवास योजना-शहरी
Description: PMAY-Urban 2.0 supports eligible urban families to construct, purchase or rent affordable housing through four programme verticals. Benefits: The four verticals are Beneficiary Led Construction, Affordable Housing in Partnership, Affordable Rental Housing and Interest Subsidy Scheme.; Assistance and conditions differ by vertical, beneficiary category and applicable guidelines.; Eligible applicants should use the official PMAY-U 2.0 portal or State and Urban Local Body channels to identify the applicable benefit. Eligibility: The household must live in an urban area and fall within the applicable income category: EWS up to Rs. 3 lakh annual household income, LIG above Rs. 3 lakh and up to Rs. 6 lakh, or MIG above Rs. 6 lakh and up to Rs. 9 lakh.; The beneficiary family must not own a pucca house anywhere in India, subject to applicable scheme guidelines.; The beneficiary or family must not have been allotted a house under a Central Government, State/UT Government or Local Self Government housing scheme during the preceding 20 years, in urban or rural areas.; All eligible family members must provide the required Aadhaar or Aadhaar Virtual ID

Scheme Name: Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana - Urban (PMAY-U)
Scheme ID: PMAY_URBAN
Category: Housing
Alternative Names: PMAY-U; PMAY Urban; PMAY Urban 2.0; PM Awas Yojana Urban; Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana Urban; प्रधानमंत्री आवास योजना शहरी; प्रधानमंत्री आवास योजना-शहरी
Government or Local Self Government housing scheme during the preceding 20 years, in urban or rural areas.; All eligible family members must provide the required Aadhaar or Aadhaar Virtual ID details.; Final eligibility depends on the selected vertical and verification by the State or Urban Local Body. Required Documents: Aadhaar details of the applicant and family members.; Applicant bank account details.; Income proof or income certificate as required.; Eligibility undertaking in the prescribed format.; Land ownership documents for Beneficiary Led Construction applications.; Caste or category certificate where applicable. Application Process: Apply through the PMAY-U 2.0 Unified Web Portal, a Common Service Centre or the concerned Urban Local Body or Municipality.; Select the applicable scheme vertical and complete the eligibility assessment.; Upload or submit the required documents and undertaking.; Wait for State, ULB and scheme-authority verification and sanction.

Scheme Name: Pradhan Mantri Awaas Yojana - Gramin (PMAY-G)
Scheme ID: PMAY_GRAMIN
Category: Rural Housing
Alternative Names: PMAY-G; PMAY Gramin; PMAY Rural; PM Awas Yojana Gramin; Pradhan Mantri Awaas Yojana Gramin; प्रधानमंत्री आवास योजना ग्रामीण; प्रधानमंत्री आवास योजना-ग्रामीण
Description: Rural housing assistance programme for eligible rural households identified through the prescribed deprivation, housing and verification process. Benefits: Eligible beneficiaries may receive Rs. 12,000 for toilet construction through convergence with Swachh Bharat Mission-Gramin.; Beneficiaries may receive 90/95 days of unskilled labour wages through MGNREGS, subject to applicable rules.; Eligible beneficiaries may be facilitated to access institutional loan support under applicable programme provisions. Eligibility: Beneficiaries are identified through the prescribed SECC and Awaas+ lists and programme exclusion checks.; Rural residence or low income alone does not establish eligibility.; The final beneficiary list and verification by the Gram Sabha and competent authorities are decisive. Required Documents: Aadhaar or other accepted identity details.; Bank or post-office account details.; Household and residence details.; Land or site details and other records requested during local verification. Application Process: Check the beneficiary list through the PMAY-G official portal or Gram Panchayat and Block Development Office.; Contact the Gram Panchayat or Block office if household details require verification.; Follow the official beneficiary verification and construction-stage process.

Scheme Name: Pradhan Mantri Jan-Dhan Yojana (PMJDY)

Category: Financial Inclusion
Alternative Names: PMJDY; Jan Dhan Yojana; Pradhan Mantri Jan Dhan Yojana; Jan Dhan; जन धन योजना; प्रधानमंत्री जन धन योजना; पीएम जन धन योजना
Description: National financial-inclusion mission enabling unbanked individuals to access basic banking, savings, remittance and eligible financial services. Benefits: A basic savings bank deposit account can be opened with no minimum balance requirement.; The account earns interest according to the bank's applicable rate.; RuPay debit card is provided to eligible account holders.; Eligible account holders may receive accident insurance cover linked to the RuPay card; coverage depends on account-opening date and applicable conditions.; Eligible account holders may access an overdraft facility up to Rs. 10,000, subject to bank assessment and scheme conditions.; The account can be used for Direct Benefit Transfer. Eligibility: Individuals who do not have a bank account can approach a participating bank branch or Bank Mitra.; Applicants must complete the bank's identity and KYC requirements.; Overdraft and insurance benefits have additional eligibility and usage conditions. Required Documents: Aadhaar number or another officially accepted identity document.; Address details or an accepted address document, as required by the bank.; A photograph and KYC information.; Where applicable, a small account may be opened under the permitted simplified KYC procedure. Application Process:

Scheme Name: Atal Pension Yojana (APY)
Scheme ID: ATAL_PENSION_YOJANA
Category: Pension / Social Security
Alternative Names: APY; Atal Pension Yojana; अटल पेंशन योजना; एपीवाई
Description: Voluntary, contribution-based pension scheme administered by PFRDA for eligible Indian citizens seeking guaranteed minimum monthly pension after age 60. Benefits: Subscribers choose a guaranteed minimum monthly pension of Rs. 1,000, Rs. 2,000, Rs. 3,000, Rs. 4,000 or Rs. 5,000 after age 60.; The spouse is entitled to the same pension after the subscriber's death, subject to scheme rules.; After the death of both subscriber and spouse, the accumulated pension wealth is payable to the nominee under scheme rules. Eligibility: Indian citizens aged 18 to 40 years with a savings bank or post-office savings account may join.; A person who is or has been an income-tax payer is not eligible to open a new APY account from 1 October 2022.; Contribution depends on joining age and selected pension amount. Required Documents: Savings bank or post-office savings account details.; Completed APY registration form.; Aadhaar and mobile details as requested by the enrolling institution.; Spouse and nominee details where applicable. Application Process: Approach the bank or post office holding the savings account.; Complete the APY registration form and select the pension amount.;

enrolling institution.; Spouse and nominee details where applicable. Application Process: Approach the bank or post office holding the savings account.; Complete the APY registration form and select the pension amount.; Authorise periodic contributions from the linked account.; Alternatively, use the official eAPY enrolment facility where available.

Scheme Name: Pradhan Mantri Jeevan Jyoti Bima Yojana (PMJJBY)
Scheme ID: PMJJBY
Category: Life Insurance
Alternative Names: PMJJBY; PM Jeevan Jyoti Bima Yojana; Jeevan Jyoti Bima; प्रधानमंत्री जीवन ज्योति बीमा योजना; जीवन ज्योति बीमा योजना
Description: Renewable one-year term life insurance scheme providing life cover to eligible subscribing bank and post-office account holders. Benefits: First-time subscribers are subject to a 30-day lien period for non-accidental death claims; accidental death is exempt from this lien period, subject to policy rules.Life insurance cover of Rs. 2 lakh on the insured subscriber's death, subject to policy terms and exclusions.; The scheme is renewable annually for the cover period from 1 June to 31 May.; The published annual premium is Rs. 436; confirm the current premium and applicable tax or policy terms before enrolment. Eligibility: Individual bank or post-office account holders aged 18 to 50 years may enrol.; The subscriber must provide consent and enable the prescribed auto-debit.; A person with multiple accounts can enrol through only one eligible account. Required Documents: Eligible savings bank or post-office account.; Completed consent-cum-declaration or enrolment form.; Identity and nominee details requested by the participating institution. Application Process: Apply through the participating bank branch, bank channel or post office.; Submit the prescribed consent and auto-debit authorisation.; Check enrolment confirmation and annual renewal status

Scheme Name: Pradhan Mantri Suraksha Bima Yojana (PMSBY)
Scheme ID: PMSBY
Category: Accident Insurance
Alternative Names: PMSBY; PM Suraksha Bima Yojana; Suraksha Bima; प्रधानमंत्री सुरक्षा बीमा योजना; सुरक्षा बीमा योजना
Description: Renewable one-year personal accident insurance scheme for eligible bank and post-office account holders. Benefits: Accidental death or permanent total disability cover of Rs. 2 lakh.; Permanent partial disability cover of Rs. 1 lakh, subject to policy definitions.; The published annual premium is Rs. 20; confirm the current premium and policy terms before enrolment. Eligibility: Individual bank or post-office account holders aged 18 to 70 years may enrol.; The applicant must provide consent and authorise auto-debit.; Only one account can be used for enrolment if the person has multiple accounts. Required Documents: Eligible bank or post-office account details.; Completed PMSBY consent-cum-declaration or enrolment form.; Nominee details and identity information requested by the participating institution. Application Process: Apply through the participating bank branch, bank channel or post office.; Provide consent and auto-debit authorisation.; Retain the acknowledgement and check annual renewal status.

Scheme Name: Pradhan Mantri MUDRA Yojana (PMMY)
Scheme ID: PM_MUDRA
Category: Micro-enterprise Finance
Alternative Names: PMMY; MUDRA; MUDRA Yojana; PM Mudra; Mudra Loan; Pradhan Mantri MUDRA Yojana; प्रधानमंत्री मुद्रा योजना; मुद्रा योजना; पीएम मुद्रा योजना
Description: Pradhan Mantri MUDRA Yojana provides institutional collateral-free credit to eligible micro-enterprises for income-generating business activities. Benefits: Shishu loans cover requirements up to Rs. 50,000.; Kishor loans cover requirements above Rs. 50,000 and up to Rs. 5 lakh.; Tarun loans cover requirements above Rs. 5 lakh and up to Rs. 10 lakh.; Tarun Plus loans cover requirements above Rs. 10 lakh and up to Rs. 20 lakh for eligible borrowers who have successfully repaid a previous Tarun loan.; Loans are assessed and sanctioned by participating lending institutions; approval is not automatic. Eligibility: Applicants must have a viable income-generating micro-enterprise proposal in manufacturing, trading, services or eligible allied agricultural activities.; Eligible applicants may include proprietorships, partnerships and other permitted micro-enterprise forms.; The lending institution assesses creditworthiness, business plan and repayment capacity. Required Documents: Identity and address proof of applicant and business.; Business address and activity details.; Business plan, quotation or project report where requested.; Bank statements and financial information where requested by the lender.; Category-specific or registration documents where applicable. Application Process: Approach a participating bank, NBFC or microfinance institution.; Discuss

Scheme Name: Pradhan Mantri Ujjwala Yojana (PMUY)
Scheme ID: PM_UJJWALA
Category: LPG / Clean Cooking
Alternative Names: PMUY; Ujjwala Yojana; PM Ujjwala; PM Ujjwala Yojana; Pradhan Mantri Ujjwala Yojana; प्रधानमंत्री उज्ज्वला योजना; उज्ज्वला योजना; पीएम उज्ज्वला योजना
Description: PMUY supports eligible adult women from poor households to obtain a deposit-free LPG connection. Benefits: Eligible beneficiaries receive a deposit-free LPG connection with specified equipment and installation charges covered under the scheme.; The connection package includes a cylinder, pressure regulator, safety hose and consumer booklet, subject to the selected connection type.; The scheme provides the applicable first refill and stove support under current PMUY rules.; The beneficiary may choose an eligible 14.2 kg or 5 kg connection option. Eligibility: The applicant must be an adult woman aged 18 years or above.; The household must not already have an LPG connection in the name of a family member.; The applicant must belong to an eligible poor household and submit the prescribed deprivation declaration and supporting documents. Required Documents: Applicant Aadhaar and completed KYC form.; Ration card or State-issued family-composition document.; Aadhaar details of adult family members listed in the family document.; Bank account passbook copy or cancelled cheque.; Address proof if the current address differs from Aadhaar address.; Prescribed deprivation declaration and migrant self-declaration where applicable. Application Process: Apply through

Scheme Name: Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana (PMFBY)
Scheme ID: PMFBY
Category: Agriculture / Crop Insurance
Alternative Names: PMFBY; PM Fasal Bima Yojana; Fasal Bima; Crop Insurance Scheme; Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana; प्रधानमंत्री फसल बीमा योजना; फसल बीमा योजना; पीएम फसल बीमा योजना
Description: Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana provides crop insurance for notified crops and areas against specified risks during notified crop seasons. Benefits: The scheme provides insurance protection for notified crop losses caused by covered risks under the operational guidelines.; Covered risks can include prevented sowing, standing crop losses from specified non-preventable risks, and post-harvest losses in eligible cases.; Farmer premium rates are generally capped at 2% for Kharif food and oilseed crops, 1.5% for Rabi food and oilseed crops, and 5% for annual commercial and horticultural crops; State notifications and current guidelines apply.; Claim amounts depend on the insured crop, notified area, sum insured, assessed loss and applicable procedure. Eligibility: Farmers growing notified crops in notified areas and having insurable interest may be covered.; Sharecroppers and tenant farmers may be eligible if they provide the required evidence permitted by the State notification.; Loanee and non-loanee farmer enrolment rules must be checked against the current season's notification and operational guidelines.; The crop, area, insurance window and cut-off date must be notified for the relevant season. Required Documents: Aadhaar and bank account

Scheme Name: Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana (PMFBY)
Scheme ID: PMFBY
Category: Agriculture / Crop Insurance
Alternative Names: PMFBY; PM Fasal Bima Yojana; Fasal Bima; Crop Insurance Scheme; Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana; प्रधानमंत्री फसल बीमा योजना; फसल बीमा योजना; पीएम फसल बीमा योजना
checked against the current season's notification and operational guidelines.; The crop, area, insurance window and cut-off date must be notified for the relevant season. Required Documents: Aadhaar and bank account details.; Land record or Record of Rights, as applicable.; Sowing certificate or other crop evidence where required.; Lease, agreement or other insurable-interest evidence for tenant or sharecropper farmers, as permitted by the State.; Application and crop details for the notified season. Application Process: Check the notified crop, insured area, insurance company and enrolment deadline for the relevant State and season.; Ensure the insured crop matches the crop actually sown and the declared land area does not exceed the actual land area.; Keep the application acknowledgement and policy details.; Report crop losses within the applicable notification and operational-guideline deadline through the prescribed channel.; Tenant farmers and sharecroppers must provide acceptable proof of insurable interest.
